result_text:
**Conversion fell mainly because a new landing page, `/lp/summer-sale`, started sending traffic on 2026-06-08. Almost none of those visitors reach checkout, and orders didn't fall.** This is an association: nothing in the data randomizes or isolates the cause.

The `/lp/summer-sale` page doesn't appear in the 06-01 week and brings about 160 sessions a day from 06-08.

- **Orders were flat.** Orders per day were 17, 19, 21, 17, 19 on 06-01 to 06-05 and 17, 20, 23, 17, 20 on 06-08 to 06-12. Sessions rose by about 760 a day, so the extra sessions diluted the rate without any loss of orders.
- **The new page barely converts.** Only 0.57% of its sessions reached checkout (6 of 1,053). That compares with 2.68% for `/home` and 3.76% for `/product`.
- **Without the new page, conversion is about the same.** Checkout-reached rates were 3.04% in week 2 against 3.12% in week 1. The bootstrap 90% interval on that difference is −0.8 to +0.7pp. Orders have no landing-page field, so I used `checkout_reached` for the per-page rates.
- **Mobile mix is not the cause.** The mobile share fell, from 56.0% to 51.1%, when a rise would have been needed for this explanation.

**Open questions**
- **The v3.4.1 checkout refactor (06-10) is not cleared.** I saw no step down after it, either in the rate excluding the new page or in daily orders. The test is too weak to exclude an effect of around 0.6pp, so it stays unresolved.
- **Your 2.5% only matches 06-08 to 06-12.** Orders divided by sessions is 2.55% for those five days and 2.76% (137 of 4,971) for the full week.
- **Session data looks incomplete on 06-13 and 06-14.** Mobile sessions drop to about 240 a day from 330–440, and all pages sit near 77% of normal volume, while orders look normal. That undercount flatters the full-week figure. I have no expected schedule to confirm whether it's a logging gap, so I can't tell.

**Suggestions:** Report conversion with and without the summer-sale traffic. Check why that page converts so poorly, for example tracking, an offer mismatch or a broken path. Look into the 06-13 and 06-14 mobile session gap.
